plan_a_advantages: More consistent aerobic volume (total minutes of aerobic work).
Includes longer aerobic sessions (30-72 minutes) to build endurance.
Better distribution of rest days for recovery.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates more consistent aerobic work with a mix of durations, building a solid aerobic base. While Plan B focuses heavily on easy runs, it lacks the volume and variety needed to truly improve speed. Plan A’s inclusion of longer aerobic sessions (30-72 minutes) directly addresses the need for increased endurance, a crucial component of trail running speed. Furthermore, the strategic placement of rest days allows for better recovery and adaptation to the training load.
